about: SWOT golden set (SWOT fix guide 2026-11-13, section 8). One entry per lead the team knows well: 8-10 things that are true and 3-4 tempting things that are false. scripts/golden-set.js checks each lead's latest SWOT against them. A false statement matches when any of its patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions) matches a SWOT point, the summary, the pitch point or a solution's problem. A true statement is 'covered' when one of its patterns matches (for information: a SWOT need not repeat every truth). type: 'absence' for false 'missing' claims (target: zero), 'fact' for other false claims (target: zero). Only Thread Stories is filled in so far, from AxiFlow's own website check of 13 Nov 2026 (facts V1-V33): the owner should review it and add the other 9 leads.
